summary.zh: 上线 AI 功能前检查评测与风险分级
summary.en: Check evals, error SLO, and EU AI Act risk before shipping AI.

description.zh: 在 AI 功能上线、签多年厂商合同或扩编 AI 团队前，要求给出评测集、量化错误率与降级方案，并判定 EU AI Act 风险等级。也用于在 API、微调和自托管之间做选择。
description.en: Before an AI feature ships, it asks for an eval set, a quantified error SLO with a fallback, and the EU AI Act risk tier. Also helps choose between API, fine-tuning, and self-hosting, or size an AI hire.
